import { ModalComponent } from './modal.component'; import { ButtonComponent } from '../button/button.component'; const meta = { title: 'Components/Modal', component: ModalComponent, tags: ['autodocs'], argTypes: { open: { control: 'boolean' }, title: { control: 'text' }, size: { control: 'select', options: ['sm', 'md', 'lg', 'xl'] }, closeOnBackdrop: { control: 'boolean' }, }, }; export default meta; export const Default = { args: { open: true, title: 'Confirm action', size: 'md' }, render: (args) => ({ props: { ...args, onClosed: () => console.log('modal closed') }, imports: [ModalComponent, ButtonComponent], template: `

Are you sure you want to delete this item? This action cannot be undone.

Cancel Delete
`, }), }; export const Large = { args: { open: true, title: 'Edit profile', size: 'lg' }, render: (args) => ({ props: args, imports: [ModalComponent, ButtonComponent], template: `

Update your profile information below.

Cancel Save changes
`, }), }; export const Small = { args: { open: true, title: 'Session expired', size: 'sm' }, render: (args) => ({ props: args, imports: [ModalComponent, ButtonComponent], template: `

Your session has expired. Please sign in again to continue.

Sign in
`, }), }; export const NoTitle = { args: { open: true, size: 'md' }, render: (args) => ({ props: args, imports: [ModalComponent, ButtonComponent], template: `

Payment successful

Your subscription has been activated. Check your email for the receipt.

Done
`, }), };
